status.description: "ok" means that the credentials were accepted and the client can join the room.

"bad" means that the credentials were not accepted.
If so, the reason field may contain a specific reason message, or empty/omitted to return a generic message.

reason.description: The reason the authentication was rejected.

status.description:
"pass" means that the provider is satisfied with the credentials, but to pass it to the next provider for actual authentication.
Used for middleware.
